chunks: He said: Abul Hasan Muhammad ibn Muzaffar al-Warraq reported to us, Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Abi al-Thalj reported to us, he said: al-Husayn ibn Ayyub informed me from his book, from Muhammad ibn Ghalib, from Ali ibn al-Hasan, from Abdullah ibn Jabalah, from Dharih al-Muharibi, from Abu Hamza al-Thumali, from Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali (peace be upon them both), from his father, from his grandfather who said:

Indeed Allah, Majestic is His Glory, sent Jibrail (peace be upon him) to Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) commanding him to testify to the wilayah of Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) during his lifetime, and to name him Commander of the Faithful before his death. So the Prophet of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) summoned nine men and said: "I have only invited you so that you may be witnesses for Allah on earth, whether you uphold it or conceal it."

Then he said: "O Abu Bakr, rise and greet Ali as Commander of the Faithful." He said: "Is this by the command of Allah and His Messenger?" He said: "Yes." So he rose and greeted him as Commander of the Faithful.

Then he said: "Rise, O Umar, and greet Ali as Commander of the Faithful." He said: "Is it by the command of Allah and His Messenger that we call him Commander of the Faithful?" He said: "Yes." So he rose and greeted him.
Then he said to al-Miqdad ibn al-Aswad al-Kindi: "Rise and greet Ali as Commander of the Faithful." So he rose and greeted him, and did not say what the two men before him had said.
Then he said to Abu Dharr al-Ghifari: "Rise and greet Ali as Commander of the Faithful." So he rose and greeted him.
Then he said to Hudhaifa al-Yamani: "Rise and greet the Commander of the Faithful." So he rose and greeted him.
Then he said to Ammar ibn Yasir: "Rise and greet the Commander of the Faithful." So he rose and greeted him.
Then he said to Abdullah ibn Mas'ud: "Rise and greet Ali as Commander of the Faithful." So he rose and greeted him.

Then he said to Buraidah: "Rise and greet the Commander of the Faithful." And Buraidah was the youngest of them in age. So he rose and greeted him. Then the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: "I have only invited you for this matter so that you may be witnesses for Allah, whether you uphold it or abandon it."

key_terms.إمرة المؤمنين: Imart al-Mu'minin - the title Commander of the Faithful, designating supreme leadership
key_terms.الولاية: Wilayah - guardianship, spiritual and political authority over the Muslim community
key_terms.رهط: Raht - a group of men, typically between three and ten
key_terms.شهداء: Shuhada' - witnesses, those who testify and bear witness

ai.seo_question: Who were the nine companions ordered by the Prophet to greet Ali as Commander of the Faithful?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Amali of al-Mufid relates that Allah commanded the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) through Jibrail to formally designate Ali ibn Abi Talib (AS) as Commander of the Faithful (Amir al-Mu'minin) during his lifetime. The Prophet summoned nine prominent companions and commanded each one individually to greet Ali with this title, making them witnesses to this designation. The narration notably records that Abu Bakr and Umar both questioned whether this was by divine command before complying, while al-Miqdad and the others obeyed without questioning.
